name: desktop-compact-mode-labels
goal: Compact Composer modes stay readable inside their buttons in ProjectAgent.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: ProjectAgent canonical ccd2f6b5d55c default desktop/tablet/mobile images clip Change and crowd Comment in compact Composer.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standard catalog checked actions and selected modes, but not caption/hit-target bounds. Add reusable caption and toolbar bounds to the same Composer and ProjectAgent cases; compare narrow real panel and wide compact preview.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 19c6976747 compact six-case red retains6 originals; narrow ProjectAgent captions fail while wide compact Composer cases pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Compact Composer sizes its icon column to content, preserves mode minimum text widths, and reuses standard6px mode padding. Public props and callbacks are unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched green28df1aabe187 at a18045bdf4 passes6 unchanged cases; red d2acfc2a19b0 had4 failures /2 passes. All6 originals on each side were individually opened.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
